decision.reason: [ev-d1948f134793] says the TCP LoadBalancer `terminationDelay` option was removed and should now be set on `TCPServersTransport`. It does not say which configuration surface is affected, and for anything beyond that it points to other documentation. The CRD schema check contradicts the reading that this is the IngressRouteTCP field: spec.routes[].services[].terminationDelay is still in the v3.0.0 IngressRouteTCP schema [ev-f7d1f0ce407c] as well as in v2.11.2 [ev-caea0ddc58f9]. Nothing in the evidence says what happens to a configuration that still sets the option (ignored, rejected or failing), so the consequence can't be written. We need the linked documentation, or the code or changelog behind it, to show the affected surface and how removed settings are handled.
